name: GTS Diesel design system
blankRule: Render as dashed outline + "Blank: waiting on client". Never invent content.
accentRules: accent is fill, numeral, rule or focus ring only
hazard stripe used exactly twice (emergency top, final band top)

components.name: Sticky header
components.behaviour: Mobile: logo plate, OPEN 24/7 chip, 44px icon-only call. Desktop: 32px utility strip (live status, spec row, address) over an 80px bar with the logo, four numbered anchors centred and a labelled call button.
components.shadcn: Button (size icon / default), Badge (outline), NavigationMenu optional
components.a11y: nav aria-label="Primary" · call has aria-label with number · 44px targets

components.name: Hero
components.behaviour: Static layout. Mono eyebrow, condensed H1 (balance), subhead, call + ghost, proof strip with “to confirm” chips, photo slot. 7/5 split desktop; stacked with full-width buttons on mobile.
components.motion: .gts-scan on eyebrow rule · .gts-signal on call button
components.a11y: single h1 · photo alt describes the shot · proof chips are text

components.name: Emergency band
components.behaviour: The one accent-filled section. Hazard-stripe top edge (use 1 of 2). “Have ready” list on 1px ink rules. Ink-filled call button with accent text.

components.name: Service bento
components.behaviour: One large tile (24/7 roadside, span 6 × 2) + four medium (span 3) on 12 columns; one column on mobile. Each: photo slot, icon chip, title, one-line benefit, 3–4 checks, “Call about this →”. Hover: top border turns accent.
components.a11y: h3 per tile · link text names the action

components.name: How it works
components.behaviour: 01 Call / 02 We come to you / 03 Back on the road. Accent-outlined numeral squares joined by a dashed rail (horizontal desktop, vertical mobile). Mono meta line in accent above each title.
components.a11y: ordered list · numerals are decorative duplicates of order

components.name: Fleet split
components.behaviour: Left 7: pitch, vehicle-type chips, fleet photo. Right 5: account card with accent top rule, spec rows (contracts, pricing, support) and a footer holding call + fleet-quote buttons.
components.a11y: dl for spec rows · two distinct CTAs

components.name: Proof grid
components.behaviour: Ruled 4-up grid (2-up mobile). Index, large condensed accent stat, label. Section-level “All figures to confirm”; fourth stat is a blank.
components.a11y: stats are text, not images · no count-up

components.name: Reviews
components.behaviour: Placeholder only: three dashed figure blanks with an empty 5-box rating row. No invented quotes, names or ratings.
components.a11y: figure / blockquote / figcaption ready for real content

components.name: Service area
components.behaviour: Blueprint map placeholder with a dashed 100-mile ring, crosshair and pulsing base marker. Spec rows (base, radius, hours), towns blank, shop-front photo slot.
components.a11y: map is decorative; facts repeated as text

components.name: FAQ accordion
components.behaviour: Sticky intro left (desktop) with phone link. Numbered rows; open row gets --surface fill, accent number and a + rotating to ×. Panel animates grid-template-rows 220ms. Payment answer is a blank.

components.name: Final call band + form
components.behaviour: Hazard edge (2 of 2). Live status, big H2, mono phone numeral, call button, spec line. Form card: Name + Phone (2-up desktop), “What’s going on?”, Fleet? switch, success / error alerts that repeat the number.
components.shadcn: Input, Label, Textarea, Switch, Button, Alert
components.a11y: visible labels · inputs 52px · role=status / alert · noValidate with own messages

components.name: Footer
components.behaviour: Ink ground. Logo and one-line description, then Contact / Hours / Sister shop columns. Bottom rule with © Matt and Dom Enterprises LLC and address.

components.name: Mobile sticky call bar
components.behaviour: 64px + safe-area inset. ~70% “Call 24/7 Dispatch” (primary), ~30% “Quote” (ghost). Shows after the hero call button scrolls away; hides when the final call band enters. Mobile only (< md).
components.a11y: aria-hidden + tabindex −1 while hidden · page has bottom padding so nothing sits under it

type.sample: Shop pricing is lower than roadside.

motion.use: Live dot ring, nav pulse line

tokens.source: src/design/tokens.css is the single source of truth; app.css exposes it to Tailwind v4
